// diagnostic L2511

Jet.HiddenCopyInLoop

{operation} inside a loop

What

{operation} inside a loop

Why

The loop pays for this copy on every turn and the source doesn't show it, so the loop's cost grows with the copied value's size.

Fix

To keep the copy out of the loop, {fix_text}.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.HiddenCopyInLoop: Tests/UI/cost_cow_shared_map_in_loop.stderr.

Error: Jet.HiddenCopyInLoop: Editing a shared map backing store inside a loop
  --> Tests/UI/cost_cow_shared_map_in_loop.jet:9:15
    |
  9 |         counts[key] = out.len()
    |               ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: The loop pays for this copy on every turn and the source doesn't show it, so the loop's cost grows with the copied value's size.
 Fix: To keep the copy out of the loop, mutate an exclusive map place, or move the edit outside the loop.
